Download the file for your system, start it, and BitMerger opens in your browser.

| System | Download |
|---|---|
| macOS (Apple Silicon: M1, M2, M3 …) | [bitmerger-macos-apple-silicon](https://github.com/REPO/releases/download/TAG/bitmerger-macos-apple-silicon) |
| macOS (Intel) | [bitmerger-macos-intel](https://github.com/REPO/releases/download/TAG/bitmerger-macos-intel) |
| Windows | [bitmerger-windows-x64.exe](https://github.com/REPO/releases/download/TAG/bitmerger-windows-x64.exe) |
| Linux (x64) | [bitmerger-linux-x64](https://github.com/REPO/releases/download/TAG/bitmerger-linux-x64) |
| Linux (ARM64) | [bitmerger-linux-arm64](https://github.com/REPO/releases/download/TAG/bitmerger-linux-arm64) |

The binaries are not signed yet. See the [README](https://github.com/REPO#readme) for the one-time "open anyway" step.
[SHA256SUMS](https://github.com/REPO/releases/download/TAG/SHA256SUMS) lets you verify the downloads.
Every file also has a build provenance attestation proving it was built from this repository by GitHub Actions:
`gh attestation verify bitmerger-linux-x64 --repo REPO`
